verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's CLI and API explicitly support creating/deleting/listing branches programmatically (pscale, API), service tokens are documented for CI/headless auth, and community evidence confirms the git-branch-to-database-branch workflow is a real, working pattern ('give you a database branch for each Git branch and help you manage the workflows around it'). Missing for 10: a first-party CI integration (e.g., official GitHub Action) or explicit docs showing automated PR-open/PR-close branch lifecycle hooks rather than manual CLI/API calls.
